top_categories.workout_context: When someone attacks on rolling urban road course at altitude, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Race-pace efforts that mimic 947 Ride Joburg's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.
60 miles on rolling urban road course at altitude burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.

Road-specific control matters at 947 Ride Joburg. Practice on rolling urban road course at altitude: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 60 miles.
76ft/mi signals a climbing-heavy course. Sustained sub-threshold and threshold work builds the steady power needed without turning the opening climb into the day’s hardest effort.
Steeper ramps, positioning, or pace changes on rolling urban road course at altitude can demand short hard efforts. Practice them without compromising the sustained work that defines the course.
Base fitness for 947 Ride Joburg. Without this, the hard workouts break you down instead of building you up.
At 947 Ride Joburg, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of 947 Ride Joburg. Train it until it feels boring.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at 947 Ride Joburg. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 4,587ft of climbing on rolling urban road course at altitude does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on rolling urban road course at altitude demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for 947 Ride Joburg's 60 miles. Start early, use products you tolerate, and carry enough between the organizer’s confirmed resupply points.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at 947 Ride Joburg. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
